learning_plan.plain_english: Logging in proves who someone is. Authorization proves what they are allowed to do after they log in.
learning_plan.plain_other_language: Iniciar sesion prueba quien es una persona. La autorizacion prueba que puede hacer despues.
learning_plan.why: Your app needs proof that logged-in users can only do allowed actions.
learning_plan.practice: Write one negative test where User A tries to access User B's data.
learning_plan.do_this_next: Find one protected action and describe who is allowed to perform it.
learning_plan.do_this_next_other_language: Encuentra una accion protegida y describe quien puede hacerla.
learning_plan.success_signal: The app blocks a user from seeing or changing someone else's data.
